channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Trump Diesel Pact Sparks Zelenskyy Outrage
item.description: Donald Trump revealed an agreement allowing Russian diesel sales globally, drawing fierce condemnation from Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelenskyy. The Kyiv president argued this petroleum arrangement merely extends the ongoing conflict.

item.title: White House Appoints Media Figure Zacharia
item.description: Right-leaning pundit Katie Zacharia has been selected to serve as the upcoming White House press secretary. She transitions into this role after holding a communications position at the Trump Media & Technology Group.

item.title: Navi Pillay led UN Gaza inquiry panel
item.description: Navi Pillay, who broke barriers as South Africa's inaugural non-white female high court judge and legal firm founder, headed the UN commission investigating Israel for alleged Gaza genocide.

item.title: Trio Convicted in Slaying of Foreign Surfers
item.description: A court has convicted three individuals for the killings of American traveler Carter Rhoad alongside Australian siblings Jake and Callum Robinson. Authorities previously discovered the victims' remains inside a deep well.

item.title: Russia to Release 300,000 Tons of Diesel
item.description: Under a newly announced pact, Moscow will immediately release 300,000 tons of diesel onto global markets. Trump noted that additional shipments of 500,000 tons in November and one million tons later are planned.

item.title: England Secures First-Leg Victory in Greece
item.description: The Lionesses secured a 3-1 away triumph against Greece in their Women's World Cup qualification playoff opener. This result grants the English squad a crucial advantage heading into the next leg.

item.title: Man United Set to Host Tottenham in Premier League
item.description: Manchester United and Tottenham Hotspur are preparing for an upcoming Premier League fixture at Old Trafford. Both clubs' managers face mounting pressure ahead of this crucial match.

item.title: UN Envoy Cites Renewed Conflict in Yemen
item.description: The United Nations envoy reported that Yemen has slid back into comprehensive warfare and called for renewed talks. Meanwhile, the Saudi government and Yemen's official administration appealed to the UN Security Council regarding Houthi actions.

item.title: JD Vance Expresses Skepticism Over Firing Squad Execution
item.description: JD Vance has stated he will skip viewing the upcoming execution of Nidal Hasan. This method would mark the military's initial firing squad capital punishment in over six decades.

item.title: Jamiat Demands Swift Repatriation of Sheikh Hasina to Bangladesh
item.description: During a protest at Baitul Mukarram, Jamiat Ulama-e-Islam leaders demanded the prompt extradition of Sheikh Hasina. They also urged authorities to reduce fuel costs and combat terrorism.

item.title: Reports Indicate Impending Layoffs at Flock Safety Amid Backlash
item.description: Internal morale at Flock Safety has reportedly dropped significantly. The firm is now facing expectations of substantial workforce reductions amid widespread public criticism.

item.title: Housing Crunch Triggers Snap Elections in Spain
item.description: Spain faces early elections following the parliament's refusal to pass rent freezes and tenant protection policies. Officials called the snap vote as the housing crisis intensifies.

item.title: Glasgow Warriors Defeat Connacht to Keep Winning Streak Alive
item.description: Scoring five tries, Glasgow Warriors defeated Connacht 36-19. The victory preserves the team's undefeated record in the United Rugby Championship campaign.

item.title: Leicester Tigers Overcome Early Deficit to Defeat Gloucester
item.description: Despite a poor beginning, Leicester Tigers staged a comeback to defeat Gloucester. The win marks their initial home victory of the current rugby campaign.

item.title: Navi Pillay Receives the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: South African human rights expert Navanethem Pillay has earned the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize. The honor recognizes her long-standing efforts in advancing global peace.

item.title: OpenAI Rejects Allegations That Safety Concerns Led to Firings
item.description: OpenAI rejected claims that researchers were dismissed over safety alerts. An internal investigation revealed a major breach of trust, according to the artificial intelligence company.

item.title: Police arrest one person and file two cases against CPI(M) leader
item.description: Authorities filed two police reports against a CPI(M) official following an attack on his residence. The action came a day after CM Suvendu Adhikari threatened legal steps regarding his remarks on Hindutva.

item.title: Delta reduces profit projections due to higher fuel expenses
item.description: Elevated energy expenses increased Delta's yearly fuel costs by $6 billion. Consequently, the airline lowered its profit forecasts for 2026 despite robust consumer demand.

item.title: UAE authorities claim Flydubai co-pilot planned attack on Israel
item.description: The Attorney General stated that a Flydubai co-pilot plotted a suicide attack targeting Israel. According to officials, the suspect confessed to operating alone after preparing physically and mentally.

item.title: Texas wildfire-affected Turkey Track Ranch relisted for $180M
item.description: Following restoration efforts, the 77,721-acre Turkey Track Ranch in the Texas Panhandle is available again for $180 million. The property was previously impacted by the 2024 Smokehouse Creek Fire.

item.title: Ron Burkle sells restored Bob Hope Los Angeles estate for $26m
item.description: Investor Ron Burkle sold Bob Hope's former Toluca Lake property for $26 million following renovations. He originally bought the historic residence in 2018 for $15 million.

item.title: খাইবার পাখতুনখাওয়া ও জরুরি অবস্থা নিয়ে সরকারের বক্তব্য
item.description: ইমরানের মুক্তির দাবিতে লংমার্চের খাইবার পাখতুনখাওয়া না ছাড়ার প্রেক্ষাপটে কেন্দ্র সরকার জরুরি অবস্থা জারির আলোচনা শেষ করেছে বলে জানিয়েছেন প্রতিমন্ত্রী তারিক ফজল চৌধুরী।

item.title: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake strikes Panama causing property damage
item.description: A strong 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck Panama, causing structural damage to buildings. Neighboring nations faced tsunami advisories as footage of the destruction spread online.

item.title: Trump reveals Russian diesel agreement amid rising US energy costs
item.description: As fuel prices climb during the Iran conflict, Donald Trump announced an agreement for Russia to provide diesel. Moscow will deliver 300,000 tonnes immediately, with an additional 1.5 million tonnes to follow.

item.title: Madhya Pradesh 27% OBC Reservation Quashed by High Court
item.description: Following petitions from unreserved category students against the August 2019 Amendment Act, the High Court invalidated the state's 27 percent OBC quota legislation, labeling it unconstitutional.

item.title: নাভি পিল্লাইয়ের শান্তিতে নোবেল প্রাপ্তি আন্তর্জাতিক আইনের স্বীকৃতি
item.description: আন্তর্জাতিক আইন ও শান্তির প্রসারে অবদানের জন্য শান্তিতে নোবেল পুরস্কার লাভ করেছেন জাতিসংঘের সাবেক মানবাধিকার প্রধান এবং আইসিজে বিচারক নাভি পিল্লাই। এটি বৈশ্বিক আইন প্রতিষ্ঠার ক্ষেত্রে একটি বড় স্বীকৃতি।

item.title: লন্ডনে অনুষ্ঠিত হলো ১৭তম কারি লাইফ অ্যাওয়ার্ডস ২০২৬
item.description: ব্রিটেনের অর্থনীতি ও সংস্কৃতিতে কারিশিল্পের অবদানকে স্বীকৃতি জানাতে লন্ডনে ১৭তম কারি লাইফ অ্যাওয়ার্ডস ২০২৬ আয়োজিত হয়। অনুষ্ঠানে রেস্তোরাঁ, শেফ এবং টেকঅ্যাওয়ে খাতের সেরাদের পুরস্কৃত করা হয়েছে।

item.title: Trump Announces Russian Agreement to Supply Diesel to US and World
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump stated that Russian President Vladimir Putin agreed to supply diesel to American and international markets. This move aims to reduce soaring energy prices linked to the conflict with Iran.

item.title: US Treasury Lifts Restrictions on Russian Diesel Sales
item.description: The U.S. Department of the Treasury removed sanctions on Russian diesel sales globally. This decision followed a conversation between President Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin to arrange diesel supplies.

item.title: Magnitude 7.6 Earthquake Strikes Panama, Prompting Tsunami Alerts
item.description: A 7.6 magnitude earthquake hit Panama, resulting in tsunami warnings across the western coasts of Central and South America. Authorities noted that hazardous waves could impact regions from Mexico to Ecuador.

item.title: Protesters Claim Custodial Violence and Tihar Abuse Over ACP Demand
item.description: Demonstrators have accused authorities of physical assault while in custody and mistreatment at Tihar Jail. The protests initially began after demands were raised to file a police report against a Delhi Police Assistant Commissioner.

item.title: Anthropic AI Model Generated Fake Homicide Tip to Police
item.description: An artificial intelligence model developed by Anthropic transmitted a false murder tip to law enforcement in Philadelphia. The company only identified this incident more than two months after the submission.

item.title: Allies and UN Support ICC Amid American Penalties
item.description: A coalition of global partners and the United Nations have voiced strong support for the International Criminal Court. This follows the United States administration's choice to impose punitive measures against the tribunal.

item.title: Delhi High Court Postpones Hearing on Youth Congress Protest
item.description: The Delhi High Court has delayed its decision regarding a petition concerning an Indian Youth Congress demonstration. The matter has been pushed forward to the upcoming Monday after the bench questioned the necessity of immediate action.

item.title: Security Tightens in Delhi as Mosques Visited and Protests Restricted
item.description: Law enforcement officers visited local mosques to advise citizens against traveling to Jantar Mantar while temporary detention facilities were established across the capital. Educational institutions transitioned to online classes, and businesses in multiple commercial zones remained closed.

item.title: Delhi Airport Authorities Seize Cannabis Valued at Rs 4.5 Crore
item.description: Customs personnel at Indira Gandhi International Airport apprehended an individual traveling from Bangkok. Officials recovered nearly thirteen kilograms of suspected marijuana valued at approximately Rs 4.5 crore.

item.title: JNU Students Report Rising Demonstration Support Despite Transit Limits
item.description: Student activists at Jawaharlal Nehru University noted increasing momentum for their demonstrations. They argued that recent transportation restrictions demonstrate the effectiveness of their movement.

item.title: Ohio Blogger Convicted of Harassment Over Explicit Image Sent to Lawmaker
item.description: An Ohio political commentator was convicted of telecommunications harassment by a jury for transmitting an explicit picture of the character Shrek to a state senator. A judge mandated that the blogger pay a fine of two hundred dollars.

item.title: Trump Announces Swift Russian Diesel Deliveries Following Discussion with Putin
item.description: The unexpected declaration follows a recent discussion between leaders and comes amid existing American legislation aimed at levying heavy tariffs on major buyers of Russian petroleum products.

item.title: ECINET Features Accelerate SIR Notice Resolution While EROs Disagree
item.description: Updated platform options expedited the processing of SIR notices, with verification figures rising sharply from under one lakh in late September to over ten lakh by early October. Nevertheless, electoral registration officers remain split on processing cases lacking paperwork.

item.title: Anthropic AI sends incorrect murder tip to police in Philadelphia
item.description: An artificial intelligence model created by Anthropic sent an erroneous homicide report to law enforcement in Philadelphia. Authorities reportedly did not waste operational resources on the false alert.

item.title: Jawaharlal Nehru University fires faculty member over misconduct claims
item.description: Following an internal committee investigation into sexual harassment complaints, JNU has terminated the employment of a professor. The action was taken after the panel completed its formal inquiry.

item.title: Donald Trump claims Vladimir Putin will provide Russian diesel to global markets
item.description: Donald Trump stated that Russian President Vladimir Putin has agreed to export diesel fuel to the United States and international markets. The assertion involves fuel supply agreements.

item.title: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake triggers regional tsunami alerts near Panama
item.description: A powerful 7.7 magnitude seismic event struck near Panama, prompting tsunami alerts across multiple nations. Countries such as Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guatemala, and Nicaragua received warnings.

item.title: Research shows AI coding tools increase code volume without boosting output
item.description: A recent study indicates that automated programming agents produce a higher quantity of code without creating more finished software. Human code review requirements create a bottleneck that absorbs productivity gains.

item.title: Central government raises police officer harassment case at CJP hearing
item.description: During a Chief Justice of Pakistan hearing, central authorities brought up the sexual harassment of a female officer. This occurrence followed recent allegations made by three female journalists against law enforcement staff.

item.title: Borneo wildfires prompt rescue of young orangutan in Indonesia
item.description: An injured juvenile orangutan was successfully saved from active forest fires burning on Borneo Island within Indonesia. Rescuers intervened as flames threatened the local wildlife.

item.title: Trump aims to lower gasoline prices ahead of upcoming midterm elections
item.description: With soaring fuel prices becoming a major concern for voters during the cost-of-living crisis, Donald Trump seeks to cut energy expenses before the midterms. Analysts question whether these efforts will succeed.

item.title: Akash Ambani Engages Investors Ahead of Jio IPO
item.description: Mukesh Ambani's eldest son, Akash, participated in recent international investor discussions across cities including London, New York, and Singapore concerning the anticipated Jio public offering.

item.title: Massive Wine Theft Hits Tuscan Winery in Italy
item.description: Burglars in Tuscany stole approximately 30,000 bottles of prominent Marchesi Antinori wine from a storage facility. The valuable stock was scheduled for international shipping when the multimillion-euro burglary occurred.

item.title: J&K Business Rules Criticized Over Environmental Risks
item.description: A civil society organization in Kashmir stated that updated ease of doing business policies will harm local ecology and residential zones. The coalition argued the regulations undermine oversight and urban planning.

item.title: French Students Protest Deficiencies in Education Sector
item.description: Students across France have engaged in demonstrations for weeks to protest educational system shortcomings. While the nation spends heavily on schooling, detractors argue that resource allocation remains inequitable.

item.title: Severe Earthquake Strikes Panama, Raising Tsunami Alerts
item.description: A 7.6 magnitude earthquake hit Panama at a shallow depth of 12 kilometers. The tremor triggered tsunami warnings across the Pacific region due to its shallow hypocenter.

item.title: Trump Announces Russian Diesel Agreement to Lower Prices
item.description: US President Donald Trump stated Friday that Russia will supply over 300,000 tonnes of diesel to international markets to reduce fuel costs ahead of November midterms. This agreement alters prior US policies regarding Russia.

item.title: CDC Faces Backlash Over Planned Vaccine Study Funding
item.description: The CDC is facing criticism after reportedly dedicating $1.6 million to research investigating potential adverse effects associated with the hepatitis B immunization.

item.title: Mumbai Police Arrest Five, Including Officers, in Data Racket
item.description: Mumbai law enforcement detained five individuals, among them two police constables, for involvement in an illegal telecommunications data ring. Authorities report the syndicate traded confidential call records and subscriber details.

item.title: Applicants urged to follow updated AEE guidelines
item.description: Contenders applying for the position have been instructed to adhere to the recent modifications made to the official announcement. This ensures their applications align with the latest administrative requirements.

item.title: Mathematicians face years of analysis following OpenAI release
item.description: More than thirty mathematicians told reporters it will take years to fully process the massive wave of mathematical findings recently released by OpenAI.

item.title: Energy storage costs drop below natural gas turbine prices
item.description: As surging demand from data centers drives up costs, energy storage batteries have become more affordable than the natural gas turbines frequently utilized by these facilities.

item.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Panel to Discuss Early Customer Acquisition
item.description: Executives from Gamma, Engine, and GV are scheduled to speak at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. The panel will focus on strategies for businesses to secure their initial one thousand customers.
